actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Accepted for the class contract; a MuJoCo reset restores the model defaults (mj_resetData) and does not use a seed
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

facts.text: The card's model is the MJCF 'planar_reach', whose root element is '<mujoco model="planar_reach">'
The model is compiled with angles in radians and autolimits enabled
The model integrates with the RK4 integrator at a 0.002 s timestep under gravity 0 0 -9.81
The default joint attributes are armature 0.01, damping 0.8 and limited true; the default motor is ctrl-limited with ctrlrange -1 to 1
The shoulder joint turns about the +z axis with the range -3.1416 to 3.1416 rad
The elbow joint turns about the +z axis with the range -3.1416 to 3.1416 rad
The arm is two links of 0.25 m: the link bodies sit 0.25 m apart and each capsule spans -0.25 to 0.25 m
The end effector is the site ee_site at the tip of link2, 0.25 m from the elbow
The target is the mocap body target_body, placed at 0.45 0.10 0.045; it is not a joint of the arm
The actuator section declares two motors: shoulder_motor with gear 2.0 and elbow_motor with gear 1.5, both with ctrlrange -1 to 1
The environment loads the MJCF with mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path and creates its state with mujoco.MjData
The environment's observation is 12 numbers: cos and sin of both joint positions, both joint velocities, the end-effector xy, the target xy and the target delta
The environment's action is the two shoulder and elbow torque commands in [-1, 1]
The environment defaults to frame_skip 10, max_episode_steps 250 and a success_threshold of 0.035 m
The target is sampled at an angle uniform in -pi to pi and at a radius uniform in 0.18 to 0.48 m
A reset draws both joint positions uniformly from -0.35 to 0.35 rad and both joint velocities from a normal distribution with scale 0.02
Each control step applies the action to data.ctrl and advances frame_skip (10) MuJoCo steps
The episode succeeds when the end-effector distance to the target is at or below the success threshold and truncates at max_episode_steps
The package requires Python 3.10 or newer and depends on mujoco 3.2.0 or newer, gymnasium 1.0.0 or newer and numpy 1.26 or newer

determinism.notes: MuJoCo integrates the MJCF deterministically from the reset state and the model has no random element, so the same ctrl sequence and tick count repeat the trajectory.  The bridge takes no seed input: a reset restores the model defaults and no seed selects a different start.  The package's fake backend is deterministic too, but its placeholder motion is not the engine's physics.

gaps: the fake backend is a stand-in for the mujoco library, not MuJoCo: it parses planar_reach.xml for the 2 ms step, the two hinge coordinates and the two motor ctrlranges and gears, then moves each joint toward gear * ctrl; it resolves no inertia, contact, friction, damping, armature or RK4 integration, so no trajectory here is a MuJoCo result

the bridge's reset calls mj_resetData and starts from the model defaults (zero qpos and qvel), not from the upstream environment's reset: env.py:116-117 draws both joint positions from -0.35 to 0.35 rad and both velocities from a normal distribution with scale 0.02, and env.py:195-206 samples and writes a target that the bridge never moves

the upstream environment's 12-number observation (env.py:49-51), its reward shaping (env.py:227-235) and its 0.035 m success threshold (env.py:35, :144) are not served: cap.world.step.v1 returns the bridge's {time, qpos, qvel} observation and the world state {time_ms, qpos, qvel, ctrl, tick, timestep_ms, seed}
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by the model's 2 ms step only; the environment's render_fps 50 (env.py:57) is a rendering rate, not the integration rate
no rendering, camera, viewer or sensor publication is served, only the integration state
the model is a simulation asset for a two-link planar arm: no physical robot is modelled or controlled and nothing here was validated against hardware

measures.description: Declared native checkpoint. Integration profile restores the full native input vector; basic profile restores only advertised state plus actuator activation and exact native time. Neither profile certifies external callbacks, plugins, RNG or hardware fidelity.
measures.name: native_checkpoint

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: after an e-stop no step or reset is accepted until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the integration state stays readable
